commands.help: Search a LastPass process for passwords and account data
commands.long_help: Scans one LastPass process ID. The Sliver argument ABI is supported, but the upstream BOF emits binary LASTPASS callback records intended for the Cobalt Strike CNA/Python post-processor; Sliver does not currently provide equivalent parsed-output post-processing.

arguments.name: pid
arguments.desc: Process ID of the LastPass process to scan
